subject: Workplace Skills
title: Stretch Assignments
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Stretch Assignments.

hook.text: Morgan McCall's research found that 70% of leadership development happens through challenging work.

buildup.text: People grow fastest when stretched slightly beyond their comfort zone. Too easy breeds boredom; too hard breeds anxiety.

discovery.text: A stretch assignment is a task just above current ability: presenting to executives, leading a cross-team project.

twist.text: The leader's role in stretch assignments is safety net, not co-pilot. Be available for help but let them navigate.

climax.text: Identify one stretch assignment for each team member this quarter. Match the stretch to their growth area.

punchline.text: Stretch them. Growth happens at the edge of comfort.

quiz.question: Where does 70% of leadership development happen according to McCall?
options: Through formal training programs and workshops
